pages.text: $(bold)EE Extractor$(): pours a crystal you are holding "into" the machine next to it.$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Right-click$() to open it - there is exactly $(bold)one slot$() inside$(li)The slot only accepts a $(bold)charged Elder Crystal / Elder Crystal Block$() (an empty crystal will not go in)$(li)Every tick it $(bold)pulls EE out of that item into its internal cache$(), and the cache is then $(bold)pushed to the EE containers next to it$(li)$(bold)Automation ready$(): hoppers / pipes / other mods can insert a crystal and pull the drained one back out from $(bold)any side$()$(li)$(bold)Automation only takes it back once it is fully drained$() (or when this block cache is full and it cannot drain any more) - $(bold)manual taking is never limited$()$() (crystal blocks / the Mana Pedestal / the Universal Energy Converter)$(br2)$(italic)In other words: no need to lay crystals all over the floor - drop one in, put a converter beside it, and the power walks out on its own.$()

pages.title: Cache and rates
pages.text: $(li)Internal cache cap = $(bold)one Elder Crystal Block worth$() ($(bold)4000 EE$()) - it holds exactly one whole block$(li)It pulls from the slot at $(bold)256 EE/t$() by default, and pushes to neighbours at $(bold)256 EE/t$() as well$(li)When the cache is $(bold)full it stops pulling$(): the EE inside the item $(bold)stays where it is$() and nothing is ever lost$(br2)$(bold)Push order$() is fixed: up, down, north, south, west, east.$(br2)$(italic)Breaking the block drops the item in the slot $(bold)with whatever EE is left in it$() - it never eats your crystal.$()

pages.title: Config
pages.text: In $(italic)config/mofengbaizhi/tinkersnewlife-common.toml$(), section $(bold)[ee_network]$():$(br2)$(li)$(bold)extractor_pull_ee_per_tick$() (default $(bold)256$()): how much EE is pulled from $(bold)the item in the slot$() each tick$(li)$(bold)extractor_push_ee_per_tick$() (default $(bold)256$()): how much EE is pushed to neighbours each tick$(li)$(bold)extractor_buffer_ee$() (default $(bold)4000$()): the internal cache cap$(br2)$(italic)These key names have not changed since the first version, so any config you already edited stays valid.$()
$(bold)Crafting$():$(br2)top middle: amethyst shard$(br)middle row: obsidian + Elder Crystal + obsidian$(br)bottom middle: quartz
